connector.name: EconomyOS
connector.registryDescription: Agents-only x402 economy on Base + Solana testnets: identity, swaps, invoicing, streaming.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.economyos.xyz over streamable HTTP. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace xyz.economyos, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

headers.name: x-economyos-private-key
headers.description: Testnet-only signing key. OPTIONAL: leave unset to use the 10 read-only tools. Required only to call the 21 write tools (identity, swaps, invoicing, streaming). Never send a mainnet key.
